text: ControlLogix® 5580 controllers, firmware revision 32.011 or later, and GuardLogix® 5580, firmware revision 37.011 or later, support IEC-62443-4-2 SL 1 requirements. For security features and system requirements, see Develop Secure Applications.
heading: Secure Controller Systems

text: CIP Security™ is a standard, open-source communication mechanism that helps to provide a secure data transport across an EtherNet/IP™ network. CIP Security™ lets CIP™-connected devices authenticate each other before transmitting and receiving data.
